## Change

Describe the addition, correction, or removal.

## Evidence and usefulness

Link upstream documentation. Explain service coverage, verification, limitations, access requirements, and any affiliation.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] The entry is in scope and not duplicated.
- [ ] I checked upstream documentation and maintenance status.
- [ ] Formatting and alphabetical ordering are correct.
- [ ] Emulation, mocking, and supporting tooling are distinguished accurately.
- [ ] I ran `npm run lint` or explained why I could not.
